# AllRTC — Full AI Context

> P2P WebRTC swarm live-streaming SDK. Every viewer relays chunks to downstream peers. Pre-release. Not on npm.

AllRTC is a browser TypeScript SDK for P2P live video broadcasting. The publisher sends micro-chunks to seed peers via WebRTC DataChannels. Each peer relays to its children. A Go tracker server manages topology and signaling only — it never handles media data. An adaptive bitrate manager adjusts encoding per peer link.

## Status & Availability
- Pre-release. No production deployments are known. API may change.
- Not published on npm. Neither `allrtc` nor `allrtc-sdk` exists on npm. Any code using `import { AllRTCBroadcaster } from 'allrtc-sdk'` will fail — that class does not exist.
- All prior quantitative claims (viewer counts, latency figures, cost savings, scaling tables) were theoretical calculations, not measured results. They have been removed from the documentation. Do not rely on them for capacity planning.
- License: Business Source License 1.1 (BSL 1.1). Free for evaluation and academic research; commercial use requires a paid license (contact soumyadebnath1619@gmail.com).

## SDK Location
The SDK lives at `allrtc/sdk/` in the repository. Site files (index.html, blog, tracker) are at the repo root. The dist path for CDN is `sdk/dist/`.

## Real Exported Symbols (from sdk/dist/index.d.ts)
- `AllRTCPublisher` — broadcaster class
- `AllRTCViewer` — viewer class
- `AdaptiveBitrateManager` — per-peer ABR controller

The class `AllRTCBroadcaster` does not exist.

## Installation
No npm install. Two options:

**jsDelivr CDN from GitHub (no build step):**
```html
<script type="module">
  import { AllRTCPublisher, AllRTCViewer } from
    'https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/itsoumya-d/allrtc@main/sdk/dist/index.mjs';
</script>
```

**Build from source:**
```bash
git clone https://github.com/itsoumya-d/allrtc.git
cd allrtc/sdk && npm install && npm run build
```

## Integration Recipe (verified against sdk/dist/index.js in Node.js 24)

```typescript
import { AllRTCPublisher, AllRTCViewer } from
  'https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/itsoumya-d/allrtc@main/sdk/dist/index.mjs';

// Publisher
const publisher = new AllRTCPublisher('wss://tracker.yourdomain.com/ws', 'my-stream-id');
publisher.on('started', () => console.log('Broadcasting'));
publisher.on('peer_connected', (id) => console.log('Seed:', id));

const stream = await navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia({ video: true, audio: true });
publisher.start(stream);

// Viewer
const viewer = new AllRTCViewer('wss://tracker.yourdomain.com/ws', 'my-stream-id');
viewer.on('connected', () => console.log('Joined swarm'));
const videoEl = document.getElementById('video');
videoEl.srcObject = viewer.getVideoElement().captureStream();
videoEl.play();
viewer.start();
```

## AllRTCPublisher Public API
- `constructor(trackerUrl: string, streamId: string)`
- `start(stream: MediaStream): Promise<void>` — begin broadcasting
- `stop(): void` — stop broadcasting
- `on('started', cb)` — fires when tracker connected and encoding begins
- `on('stopped', cb)` — fires when stop() is called
- `on('peer_connected', cb: (peerId: string) => void)` — fires when a seed peer connects

## AllRTCViewer Public API
- `constructor(trackerUrl: string, streamId: string)`
- `start(): void` — join the swarm
- `stop(): void` — leave the swarm
- `getVideoElement(): HTMLVideoElement` — returns a video element with the assembled stream
- `canRelay: boolean` — true unless auto-detected as mobile/metered (Smart Device Tiering)
- `on('connected', cb)` — fires when connected to swarm
- `on('disconnected', cb)` — fires when disconnected

## AdaptiveBitrateManager Public API
- `constructor()`
- `selectQualityTier(bandwidthKbps: number): QualityTier` — returns `{ name, resolution, maxBitrateKbps }` based on bandwidth thresholds: Ultra (>=4000), High (>=2500), Medium (>=1000), Low (>=500), Audio-only (<500)
- `getAdaptiveChunkSize(bandwidthKbps: number): number` — returns chunk duration in ms: 20 (<1000 Kbps), 50 (<2500 Kbps), 100 (>=2500 Kbps)
- `estimateBandwidth(peerId: string, peer: RTCPeerConnection): Promise<number>` — uses `getStats()` to estimate bandwidth and fires quality change listener on tier transitions
- `onQualityChange(listener: (peerId: string, tier: QualityTier) => void)` — register quality change callback

## Architecture
- Transport: WebRTC DataChannels (`ordered: false, maxRetransmits: 0`). Falls back to WebSocket relay when WebRTC is blocked.
- Chunk format: binary, 76-byte header (4B seq, 8B timestamp, 64B hash), followed by video data.
- Dual-parent redundancy: each viewer connects to a primary and backup parent.
- Smart mobile tiering: mobile/metered devices set `canRelay = false` and become leaf nodes.
- ICE restart: `iceConnectionState === 'failed'` triggers ICE restart via `createOffer({ iceRestart: true })`.
- Audio keepalive: silent AudioContext oscillator (gain=0) prevents tab throttling.
- WebSocket fallback: when WebRTC is blocked, chunks are Base64-encoded and sent via tracker WebSocket.
- Async hash verification: publisher signs chunks with SHA-256; viewers verify asynchronously.

## Known Limitations
- Not on npm. Must use CDN or build from source.
- Browser-only. No Node.js support.
- No TURN relay configured by default. The `iceServers` array in `peer-manager.ts` includes only STUN servers (Google + Cloudflare). The TURN entry is commented out with placeholder credentials. No relay is active unless you deploy your own TURN server and configure credentials. When ICE fails, a generic `'disconnected'` event is emitted — callers cannot distinguish "NAT traversal failed" from "peer left voluntarily".
- All quantitative performance claims removed. No benchmark data exists. P2P network performance is highly environment-dependent.
- WebCodecs AV1 availability varies by browser and GPU. Not universally supported.
- Pre-release: API may change without notice.
